ops.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. EU AI ACT — DIGITAL OMNIBUS DEAL REACHED: In the early hours of 7 May 2026, eight days after last week's failed trilogue, Council and Parliament negotiators reached provisional agreement on the Digital Omnibus on AI. The high-risk obligations are postponed — Annex III to 2 December 2027 and Annex I to 2 August 2028. The Annex I conformity-assessment dispute that broke the previous trilogue is resolved. A new Article 5 prohibition on AI systems generating child sexual abuse material or non-consensual intimate imagery is added. Watermarking compliance for pre-existing systems is set at 2 December 2026 — earlier than the Commission's original 2 February 2027 proposal. Formal endorsement and legal-linguistic revision must complete before 2 August 2026. AUSTRALIA: The first mandatory requirement under the Policy for the responsible use of AI in government begins 15 June 2026 — approximately five weeks away. The technology-neutral stance holds. FUNDING: AI-adjacent seed rounds are running at $10M / $40-45M post-money; median pre-money around $17.9M. Pre-seed averages $1.2M (median $750K); seed VCs are compensating for valuation inflation by moving earlier into pre-seed. SOLO FOUNDER: Zoom launched the inaugural Solopreneur 50 on 4 May 2026 — nearly 3,000 applicants, $150K in grants. ASYNC: 85% of remote businesses report measurable productivity gains from collaboration tooling tied to a system of record. RISKS: If Omnibus formal adoption slips past 2 August 2026, the original AI Act dates re-activate. OPPORTUNITIES: The Annex III runway extension to December 2027 gives any future in-scope system time to harden documentation rather than scramble.

tech.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. ANTHROPIC: Opus 4.7 is GA at unchanged pricing ($5/$25 per million tokens). The advisor tool is in beta on the Claude Platform (anthropic-beta: advisor-tool-2026-03-01). Anthropic signed a SpaceX Colossus 1 compute deal — ~300MW and 220,000+ NVIDIA GPUs coming online within the month, materially expanding capacity. Project Glasswing (Claude Mythos Preview) has expanded its invited set to include AWS, Apple, Cisco, Google, JPMorgan Chase, and Microsoft. VERCEL: A coordinated Next.js security release this week patches 13 advisories — DoS in React Server Components, connection exhaustion with Cache Components, cache poisoning, XSS in App Router CSP-nonce / beforeInteractive paths, and an upstream React Server Components issue tracked as CVE-2026-23870. Patching is the only complete mitigation. Vercel Flags now accept JSON values; Pro teams gain controls for private-repo Git committer approval. SUPABASE: Pricing unchanged ($0 / $25 Pro / $599 Team / Enterprise). SECURITY — TWO CRITICAL CVEs: CVE-2026-31431 ('Copy Fail') is a Linux kernel authenc-template bug allowing local privilege escalation via a 732-byte script on essentially every Linux distribution since 2017. CISA added it to the KEV catalogue; federal patching deadline was 15 May 2026. CVE-2026-41940 is a pre-auth bypass in cPanel & WHM (CVSS 9.8), being mass-exploited in the wild against ~1.5M internet-facing instances. TYPESCRIPT: 7.0 (stable 15 January 2026) remains the live version; ecosystem packages still adapting. LLM COSTS: Tiered routing continues to deliver 40-60% savings; Anthropic prompt-caching (~90% off cached input) and batch APIs (50% off) remain the cheapest levers. RISKS — FOUNDER ATTENTION: Patch Next.js immediately; verify Linux kernel patch status on any hosted infrastructure for CVE-2026-31431. OPPORTUNITIES: Anthropic's compute expansion reduces near-term rate-limit risk during launch windows.

growth.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. AGENT INFRASTRUCTURE: Microsoft 365 E7 and Microsoft Agent 365 reached general availability on 1 May 2026. Agent 365 is explicitly positioned as a 'control plane to govern and scale agents' across local, SaaS, and cloud environments — the first hyperscaler GA of agent governance infrastructure (rather than agent products). The agent-marketplace landscape has consolidated into eight surfaces in Q2 2026: Claude Skills, GPT Store, MCP Hubs, Hugging Face Spaces, Replit Agent Market, LangChain Hub, Vercel Agent Gallery, and Cloudflare AI Marketplace. COMPETITORS: Virtue AI's PolicyGuard (29 April 2026) is now better documented — it converts natural-language or PDF-uploaded policies into runtime-enforceable guardrails, stacks 30+ compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR, FINRA, MLCommons), and extends policy enforcement to tool calls and multi-step workflows. Framing is governance/security, not virtue ethics — brand-confusion risk continues to live in the word 'virtue,' not in the work. STOIC COMMUNITY: Stoic Week 2026 drew 3,300+ participants from over 40 countries; Reddit/X Stoicism content shows ~400% year-on-year growth. Recent conference programming continues to emphasise engaged citizenship and the social-engagement reading of oikeiosis — directionally aligned with SageReasoning's positioning. API-FIRST: The API economy is projected at $20.2B in 2026 (17.9% CAGR). 51% of organisations have deployed AI agents; 89% of developers use AI tools, but only 24% design APIs for AI agents. 'Agent experience (AX)' is emerging as a recognised design discipline. RISKS: Virtue AI's name and the broader 'guardian agent' category continue to create brand-confusion exposure for agent-developer audiences. OPPORTUNITIES: The 89/24 AX gap remains live ground; consolidated marketplace surfaces simplify distribution planning for the sage-reason API.

support.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. MENTAL HEALTH AI — REGULATORY VELOCITY: New data sharpens last week's picture. In Q1 2026, 36 states introduced 70+ bills regulating AI chatbots; most include AI-disclosure requirements. Illinois and Nevada have completely banned AI for behavioural health. New York's law (now confirmed) requires AI chatbots to detect suicidal ideation, refer users to crisis hotlines, and regularly disclose non-human status; Utah is broadly aligned. A 50-state legislative review (PMC) documents the rapid expansion. AI SAFETY INCIDENTS: The 2026 AI Index records 362 documented incidents in 2025 (up from 233 in 2024). The OECD AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor recorded a peak of 435 monthly incidents in January 2026 (six-month moving average 326). Organisations rating their AI-incident response 'excellent' dropped from 28% to 18% year-on-year. PUBLIC SENTIMENT: An NBC News March survey records 26% of Americans viewing AI positively versus 46% negative. The April Gallup release on Gen Z is now contextualised by Princeton's Bridging Divides Initiative reporting an uptick in harassment and threats around AI and data centres. ACCESSIBILITY: The ADA WCAG 2.1 Level AA deadline of 24 April 2026 is now in force for covered public entities. A Federal Register notice extended state/local government deadlines (population 50K+: 26 April 2027; under 50K and special districts: 26 April 2028). The HHS Section 504 healthcare deadline of 11 May 2026 lands today. WCAG 3.0's next Working Draft is expected around September 2026; ISO/IEC 40500:2026 (WCAG 2.2) is expected late 2026. RISKS — FOUNDER ATTENTION: New York's specific requirements (suicidal-ideation detection, crisis referral, non-human disclosure) continue to read as a template other states and federal regulators are likely to adopt; R20a should be designed against this template, not last year's framework. OPPORTUNITIES: Regulatory direction continues to align with R19/R20 commitments. Section 504's date arriving today makes WCAG 2.1 AA the active industry baseline.
